# Pratik S Pawar - Portfolio

> "Namaste! I'm Pratik S Pawar, a developer passionate about crafting the web with logic and creativity. My only tech stack: my brain."

## About
Pratik S Pawar is a developer specializing in web development, applied artificial intelligence, machine learning, and cybersecurity. He builds high-performance web applications, data-driven systems, and automation workflows.

## Selected Projects & Work
- [Legal-Sakha](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Deep learning-powered legal assistant utilizing NLP and TensorFlow.
- [ani-realm](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Anime community web platform built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- [fitfocus](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Personal fitness tracking companion application developed with Next.js, React, and Node.js.
- [India Population Insights Dashboard](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Interactive data visualization dashboard for demographic data using D3.js and React.
- [GenAi Intern at DoorDecor](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Built AI-powered automation workflows, AI content agents, and SEO/analytics integration using n8n and AI APIs.
- [Automation-Workflows](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Collection of practical AI workflows for daily tasks using n8n and Docker.
- [PotholeSahayak](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Computer vision and ML model detecting potholes for road safety using Python and OpenCV.
- [Lung-Check](https://github.com/PratikPawar020403): Deep learning system for early detection in medical imaging.

## Technical Skills
- Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, SQL
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Framer Motion
- Backend & Automation: Node.js, Express, n8n, REST APIs, Supabase, PostgreSQL
- Machine Learning & Data: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV, Scikit-learn, Pandas, D3.js
- Tools: Docker, Git, Linux, Netlify
